_comment: The in-game playtest survey (issues #148, #168; docs/PLAYTEST.md). Pages are shown in order. Every page before the one marked "ai": true is neutral and never mentions AI, so a tester who brings it up there does so unprompted (tools/playtest_report.py counts those). Opening the AI page locks the earlier answers. Question types: scale (pick 1 of n, n labels), choice (pick 1), multi (pick any), text (a few lines), line (one line), character (pick 1 of the characters in the tester's roster, or 'someone else' plus a line). Answers that are left blank are fine everywhere: nothing is required. Change the wording only between rounds and bump version, so rounds stay comparable.
